source_pilot_limit: V5 supplies 5 seeds, only its own six recipes and 55 exposed dates; it cannot supply 20-rival covariance or 4-panel market power. Selection was post-hoc.

planning_pilot.stage: permitted future development planning, not run in this task
planning_pilot.count_caveat: 420 is21x4x5 opportunity slots, not420 required neural fits. There are16 neural systems including candidate, so a5-seed reference is320 neural fits, plus4 ARIMA fits under a deterministic shared-fit policy and16 analytic trajectories. Tuning/SAE subphases and failures are counted separately. Actual policy must be frozen.
required_inputs: all seed-paired RMSE and MAE for candidate and all 20 rivals
full joint vector of D_s and W_s across rivals and panels with common seed IDs
per-endpoint errors to audit fixed-calendar robustness and date/regime influence
seed-distribution symmetry/normality/tail diagnostics treated as evidence, not proof
selection/validation/planning separation and complete failure/cost/attempt logs
T sensitivity on development blocks chosen before losses; no reuse as final reserve
planning_pilot.no_circular_gate: The planning pilot does not need final power before producing its variance/covariance inputs. Its own data/budget/source registration precedes it.
planning_pilot.seed_selection: new random independent seed IDs sampled and source-bound before fits; no removal by bad performance; deterministic algorithms stored once by reference

analytic_screen.note: Only an initial normal approximation. theta_alt_W must be strictly >0; gain exactly2% is the practical-null boundary and cannot be a90%-power alternative. For W use variance of .98*RMSE_rival-RMSE_candidate, not variance of D copied blindly.

exact_p_resolution.tail_precision_rule_proposal: Choose B so expected tail exceedances at alpha/120 are at least100 (B>=240000) or derive an exact Monte Carlo confidence decision rule with its own error allocation. A minimal attainable p is not sufficient tail calibration.
exact_p_resolution.common_resampling: same paired-seed resampling indices across all model vectors; reproducible stream and no dropping failed or zero-SE draws
exact_p_resolution.interpretation: 13 is the conservative effective nonzero seed count to cross the first/Bonferroni120 threshold with an exact bilateral Wilcoxon without ties. Some full Holm orderings may allow fewer; this does not establish power or authorize R=10.

method_validation.status: NOT_EXECUTED; final executable method hashes and feasibility timing required before any new random validation
method_validation.not_inherited: Prior crossed RMSE validation failures remain; this different conditional method needs its own pre-execution anchor. Prior tolerances .08/.13 are not approval criteria.
deterministic_guards: D/W algebra and relative ratio-of-means equivalence
analytic paired t fixtures and negative-direction handling
enumerated signed-rank exact p with zeros and equal absolute ranks; no silent scipy method auto-switch
bootstrap plus-one p, >= ties, exact order statistic and closed-CI inversion on boundary fixtures
zero SE, deterministic rival, all-zero D/W, invalid covariance and unsupported assumptions retain slots and return no success
Holm 120 correctness under arbitrary rival dependence; no missing-slot shrinkage
complete model/seed/date IDs and one-time export/idempotent evaluator checks
negative signed D fixture retains small bilateral raw p while positive-direction decision p=1; separate180-slot Holm inferiority family detects the adverse additional-panel result

DGP_cases.purpose: all EPA mean/shift nulls, bounded symmetric paired differences and common positive base risks; verify exact null truths analytically
W shift/mean exactly0, EPA may be favorable. Validate margin-null false superiority separately.
mixtures of true EPA nulls, true practical nulls and alternatives, with different true-null components per rival; require strong family control
common seed factor, rival correlations 0,.5,.9 and heterogeneous scales; pairing and Holm tested
symmetric t-like finite-variance/high-moment distributions within supported assumptions, plus explicit outside-moment stress as unsupported rather than pass
mean0 but nonzero signed-rank location, skewed mixtures and rare extremes. Demonstrate no mean inference from Wilcoxon when symmetry fails; no R3 success in unsupported scope
deterministic controls, vanishing variance and positive risks near0; invalid studentizers are failures, never certain victories
whole-decision power under gain>2%, realistic covariance, and weakest-rival bottleneck; not market certification from synthetic effect choices

method_validation.truth_oracles: Derive mean, relative gain and signed-rank/symmetric shift separately before draws. Generate nonnegative RMSE arrays; do not call arbitrary Gaussian losses feasible without a positive-risk construction. Full family matches20 rivals/120 slots.
method_validation.T_role: Conditional seed tests treat T fixed. T is varied only in development planning to assess calendar and effect stability; it is not an iid multiplier for seed power.
method_validation.counts_status: PROPOSED_CEILINGS_SUBJECT_TO_DETERMINISTIC_FEASIBILITY_AND_PUBLIC_FINAL_ANCHOR; not executed or sufficient by assertion
endpoints: any false component rejection in 120 slots
any false rival declared successful under all6 components and effect/CI conditions
all-rival R3 statistical-core false success under full/partial nulls
marginal and simultaneous CI coverage for D and relative gain
all three-method success and worst-procedure p distribution
per-rival full-core power and all-rival joint power
full four-panel decision power reported separately from one-panel core
additional inferiority screen:180 negative-direction D slots; retain raw bilateral p and count false/missed adverse flags separately from positive-direction primary success
method_validation.MC_uncertainty: Exact binomial Clopper-Pearson intervals for event rates; simultaneous intervals across prespecified case/endpoints with explicit Bonferroni allocation. MC standard errors and completed counts included.
method_validation.calibration_rule: No finite MC sample proves exact nominal level. Before final random validation fix an admissible finite-design tolerance and its scientific justification, then require simultaneous upper bounds within that tolerance and report discrepancy from .05. Do not inherit old exploratory .08/.13 or widen after outcomes. Without this decision/derivation, validation is not ready.
unresolved_final_validation_inputs: supported moment and symmetry scope and planning diagnostics thresholds
finite-design calibration tolerance and MC endpoint count/error allocation
feasible B/R grid and exact time/storage ceiling
method_validation.failure_policy: Any source change, support failure within the claimed regular scope, missing case or resource stop is incomplete/fail. No same-protocol top-up after seeing rates; revised method gets a new version/anchor.

market_design_search.R_candidates: start at max(10, exact-test effective n lower bound, analytic screen); increase until full-contrast criterion passes or resource ceiling makes it infeasible; no final upper bound invented
market_design_search.T_candidates: predeclared development-only calendar lengths with adequate raw supports; no final T chosen on reserved-test gains
market_design_search.criterion: For every rival, estimate probability that all6 Holm tests, direction, practical/effect/CI requirements pass jointly; require the simultaneous lower MC confidence bound >=.90 at the agreed planning alternative. Report per-panel power and extra-panel consistency power separately.
market_design_search.uncertainty: Use a conservative, predeclared set of nuisance variances/correlations/tails from development rather than a single optimistic plug-in; report pilot uncertainty and range. Five pairs are a minimum input, not guaranteed stable covariance.
market_design_search.joint: Measure all-rival conjunction using joint samples; do not multiply marginal probabilities under an unverified independence assumption. Report full four-panel/adequacy-conditional joint power distinctly; failure to model adequacy prevents claiming full-R3 power.
market_design_search.if_infeasible: Increase R/T within declared resources before final protocol, revise development design prospectively, or retain infeasible/inconclusive result. Never shrink the rival family or pretend 10 seeds suffice.
market_design_search.inferiority_screen: Include the declared180-slot additional-panel negative-direction D family in full four-panel decision power/error accounting; do not infer noninferiority from no rejection.

reference_budget_not_final.scope: A root-requested arithmetic illustration only, not final R, achieved fit time, enough power, or cost estimate. R=10 is insufficient for the worst exact Wilcoxon/Holm120 threshold under the proposed full family. Excludes tuning, failed attempts/recovery, SAE phases beyond the allowed system budget, ARIMA, inference/export/storage and Colab interruptions.

second_reference.scope: Same nominal120-second arithmetic; excludes all additional overheads and has no measured success, final budget or adequate-power claim.

final_seed_bank.selection_rule: first R entries; determine R before final execution; no outcome-based replacement

final_seed_selection.rule: first R archived independent random IDs, R frozen after power planning and before test release
final_seed_selection.larger_R: prepare a new prospective bank/protocol before any test release; do not recycle IDs
